testcase.name: GET /clinicians
GET /reports/daily
testcase.failure:
1. Test Case ID: LfwW8Q
- ST401 API accepts requests without authentication
Expected 401 or 403, got `200 OK` for `GET /reports/daily`
[200] OK:
`{"date": "2026-11-12", "booked": 1, "cancelled": 1}`
Reproduce with:
curl -X GET 'http://127.0.0.1:8140/reports/daily?date=2026-11-12'

1. Test Case ID: XXJ7d6
- ST203 Missing required header accepted
Got 200 when missing required 'Authorization' header, expected 401
[200] OK:
`{"date": "2026-11-12", "booked": 1, "cancelled": 1}`
Reproduce with:
curl -X GET 'http://127.0.0.1:8140/reports/daily?date=2026-11-12'
